query: SELECT o.id, o.status, oi.item_id, oi.quantity, oi.price FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.id = $1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = $1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = $1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE city = $1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE age = $1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE category = $1
